target.title: Make OpenAI base URL overridable for local/compatible servers
target.body:
## Summary

Adds `resolveOpenAIBaseUrl` so Birdclaw can target Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible server instead of hardcoding `https://api.openai.com/v1`.

- Overridden **only** by the Birdclaw-specific `BIRDCLAW_OPENAI_BASE_URL`; default stays `https://api.openai.com/v1`.
- The ambient `OPENAI_BASE_URL` convention is **deliberately ignored** so a value another tool exported in the shell cannot silently redirect Birdclaw's API-key-bearing requests or archive-derived prompts (addresses review P1 / security-boundary).
- Trailing slashes are trimmed so callers can safely append `/responses`, `/chat/completions`.
- Inbox-scoring chat-completions call (`src/lib/openai.ts`) and the Responses-API hybrid-analysis runtime (`src/lib/openai-response-runtime.ts`) both build endpoints from the resolved base URL.
- `BIRDCLAW_DEBUG` logs the request URL, HTTP status, and truncated error body to stderr for both paths.
- Documented `BIRDCLAW_OPENAI_BASE_URL`, `BIRDCLAW_OPENAI_MODEL`, and `BIRDCLAW_DEBUG` in `docs/configuration.md`.

## Usage

```bash
export OPENAI_API_KEY=ollama
export BIRDCLAW_OPENAI_BASE_URL=http://localhost:11434/v1
export BIRDCLAW_OPENAI_MODEL=llama3.1
```

Note: inbox scoring uses `/chat/completions` (widely supported, e.g. Ollama); the analysis features use OpenAI's `/responses` API, which requires a server that speaks that shape.

## Real-behavior proof

Ran inbox scoring against a local OpenAI-compatible mock server (stands in for Ollama) with `BIRDCLAW_DEBUG=1`. Birdclaw hit the configured base URL — not `api.openai.com` — and returned a real score:

```
# mock server log (received the request)
[mock] OpenAI-compatible server on http://localhost:11434/v1
[mock] POST /v1/chat/completions auth=Bearer sk-lo...

# birdclaw debug + result (key redacted)
[birdclaw:openai] POST http://localhost:11434/v1/chat/completions (model=llama3.1)
SCORED: {"model":"llama3.1","score":87,"summary":"concrete SDK bug report with repro","reasoning":"specific, actionable, high signal from a known contributor"}
```

## Test Plan

Ran tests (openai, openai-response-runtime, analysis-runtime, inbox) + `tsc --noEmit`. Resolver coverage asserts the default, the `BIRDCLAW_OPENAI_BASE_URL` override with trailing-slash trim, and that ambient `OPENAI_BASE_URL` is ignored; a request test asserts traffic hits the configured base URL.
